tldr: 台股週五重挫 1,195.97 點（2.67%）收 43,654.84 點，國際科技股走弱加上外資大賣重擊指數。
台積電上調 2026 年資本支出至 600–640 億美元，並傳自 2027 年調漲代工價最高 10%，牽動 AI 晶片供應鏈。
監理端擴大財管開放：土銀取得高資產執照（第 25 家），金管會同步備妥「金融大回饋」指引。

items.title_zh: 台股週五殺盤重挫近 1,200 點
items.title_en: TAIEX plunges nearly 1,200 points as Friday selloff deepens
items.summary_zh: 加權指數週五終場大跌 1,195.97 點、跌幅 2.67%，收 43,654.84 點，成交量放大至 7,924 億元。權值王台積電跌 55 元至 2,350 元。盤面跟隨隔夜美股與亞洲科技股回檔，延續近期高波動格局，市場對 AI 高估值的疑慮再度升溫。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index tumbled 1,195.97 points, or 2.67%, to close at 43,654.84 on Friday, with turnover swelling to NT$792.4bn. Chip bellwether TSMC fell NT$55 to NT$2,350 as the market tracked overnight declines on Wall Street and across Asian tech names, extending a volatile stretch that has questioned lofty AI valuations.

items.title_zh: 外資連賣狂砍台股，台幣貶破 32 元
items.title_en: Foreign investors dump Taiwan shares, TWD breaches 32
items.summary_zh: 外資三個交易日合計賣超近 2,000 億元，本月稍早一度拖累指數失守 47,000 點，並帶動新台幣貶破 32 元大關。南亞科、華邦電、力成等記憶體族群成為賣壓重災區，反映資金自高本益比科技股大舉撤離。
items.summary_en: Overseas funds sold a net of nearly NT$200bn over three sessions, dragging the index below the 47,000 mark earlier in the month and pushing the Taiwan dollar past the 32-per-USD level. Memory names including Nanya Tech, Winbond and Powertech were among the hardest hit, reflecting a broad rotation out of high-valuation technology plays.

items.title_zh: 台積電上調 2026 資本支出至 600–640 億美元
items.title_en: TSMC raises 2026 capex to US$60–64bn on AI demand
items.summary_zh: 台積電法說會將全年資本支出上修至 600–640 億美元，並加碼 1,000 億美元投資亞利桑那，反映 AI 與高效能運算需求強勁。約 70–80% 資金投入先進製程，2 奈米放量成為成長亮點，CoWoS 先進封裝產能也持續擴充。
items.summary_en: At its Q2 earnings call, TSMC lifted its full-year capital-spending budget to US$60–64bn and pledged an additional US$100bn for Arizona, citing insatiable demand for AI and high-performance computing. About 70–80% of spending targets advanced nodes, with 2nm ramping as a key growth driver and CoWoS advanced-packaging capacity continuing to expand.

items.title_zh: 台積電傳 2027 年起代工漲價最高 10%
items.title_en: TSMC reportedly to raise foundry prices up to 10% from 2027
items.summary_zh: 據《日經亞洲》報導，台積電計畫自 2027 年起調漲晶圓代工價格，涵蓋先進與成熟製程，依客戶與產品調幅 5–10%。漲價主因反映材料、設備及海外建廠成本攀升；若客戶追加超出預估的 HPC 訂單，恐再加收 10–15% 溢價。
items.summary_en: According to Nikkei Asia, TSMC plans to lift wafer-foundry pricing across both advanced and mature nodes from 2027, with increases of 5–10% depending on customer and product. The hike reflects rising costs for materials, equipment and overseas fabs; customers adding HPC orders beyond forecast may face a further 10–15% premium.

items.title_zh: 金管會 7 月將公布「金融大回饋」指引
items.title_en: FSC to publish "financial give-back" guideline in July
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆表示，將於 7 月發布「金融大回饋」指引，引導金融業在追求獲利成長之餘兼顧社會責任與社會投資。此舉顯示監理端對獲利創高的金融機構回饋社會的期待升高，期望盈餘能轉化為更廣泛的公共效益。
items.summary_en: FSC Chairman Peng Jin-long said the regulator would release a "financial give-back" guideline in July, aiming to steer banks and insurers toward balancing profit growth with social responsibility and social investment. The move signals rising supervisory expectations that record-earning financial institutions channel gains into broader public benefit.

items.title_zh: 土銀取得財管 2.0 執照，累計 25 家銀行獲准
items.title_en: Land Bank wins high-asset wealth licence, 25th bank approved
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意台灣土地銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品與服務，成為第 25 家取得「財管 2.0」執照的銀行。土銀原則上有望於年底前開辦，國銀爭搶高資產客群的競爭態勢進一步升溫。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved Bank of Taiwan's peer Land Bank to offer financial products and services for high-net-worth clients under the "Wealth Management 2.0" framework, bringing the total number of licensed banks to 25. Land Bank is expected to launch the business by year-end, intensifying competition among domestic banks for affluent clients.

items.title_zh: 高資產財管規模衝 2.4 兆元，客戶數創新高
items.title_en: High-asset AUM hits NT$2.4tn as client base sets record
items.summary_zh: 截至 3 月底，銀行高資產財管管理規模達 2.4 兆元、年增 55%，符合資格客戶數攀升至 23,206 人、年增 72%，雙創新高。資產配置仍以存款約 42% 為最大宗，其次為基金 17%、債券 14.5%、保險 12% 與境外結構型商品約 8%。
items.summary_en: Assets managed under banks' high-net-worth wealth business reached NT$2.4tn as of end-March, up 55% year-on-year, while the number of qualifying clients climbed to a record 23,206, up 72%. Deposits remain the largest allocation at about 42%, followed by funds (17%), bonds (14.5%), insurance (12%) and offshore structured products (8%).

items.title_zh: 高股息 ETF 領跑今年績效榜
items.title_en: High-dividend ETFs dominate this year's performance table
items.summary_zh: 在股市震盪之際，高股息 ETF 持續吸引散戶資金湧入，今年績效前十名涵蓋多檔熱門台股掛牌產品。財管信託平台亦新增多檔 ETF，包括標普 500、美國科技巨頭與全球收益債券基金等，為在波動中追求收益的投資人擴大配置選擇。
items.summary_en: Amid choppy equity markets, high-dividend ETFs have drawn heavy retail inflows, with the year's top-ten performers ranging across popular Taiwan-listed products. The wealth-management channel has also added multiple new ETFs — including S&P 500, US mega-cap tech and global income bond funds — broadening options for yield-seeking investors navigating volatility.
